summary:
Reviewed w126's one implementer commit, 97a0cec (work request, requests r1-r5). The branch work/w126 is gone, so the commit was found between the claim and done commits on HEAD.
No change under features/, and no test removed or weakened. The allowances say none, which holds. The 10 requests scenarios pass, and size is clean.
r1-r5 hold. The commit it makes serves r12, so it is not code without a line.
Fix now (Important): a missing --lines file crashes with an uncaught FileNotFoundError traceback instead of a refusal (work-queue r7). Verified by reading; the probe run was refused.
Observations (Minor): vulture finds an unused 'named' in the origin step, which asserts fixed values; --source with --thread silently drops the sources; an empty lines file writes a request with no lines; a newline in title or values goes into the frontmatter unchecked.
